site.intro: Your field notes for Whiteout Survival. From city building to alliance teamwork, make every decision with a little more preparation.
site.about: Your field notes for city development, hero growth and alliance teamwork. Some guides are sample notes; follow the latest in-game information for exact values, unlock requirements and event rules.

guides.title: Getting started: build your survival routine
guides.summary: A first checklist for the frozen world, covering tutorials, the Furnace and daily planning.

sections.heading: Learn your city through the tutorial
sections.body: Complete the in-game tutorial to learn about the Furnace, resource buildings, survivor needs and the task interface. Check unlock requirements before spending materials on features you cannot use yet.

sections.heading: Create a daily checklist
sections.body: Check survivor status, construction queues, claimable rewards and alliance messages when you log in. Before leaving, plan construction or gathering around your next login.

sections.heading: Keep your options open
sections.body: Read item descriptions before using speedups or rare items. These are general sample notes; adapt them to your server and game version.

guides.title: Furnace and city: your upgrade checklist
guides.summary: Check prerequisites and resources first, then develop your city at a pace that suits you.

sections.heading: Check prerequisites
sections.body: Review the buildings, resources and time required in the upgrade interface. List any missing requirements and complete the ones blocking progress first.

sections.heading: Plan resources and queues
sections.body: Arrange gathering and construction based on your actual needs. Check storage protection and available resources before claiming large amounts you cannot use immediately.

sections.heading: Check survivor status
sections.body: As your city grows, review survivor needs and the facilities that support them. Follow in-game information for exact effects and mechanics.

guides.title: Hero growth: spend resources with purpose
guides.summary: Review hero roles and training priorities to create a manageable development plan.

sections.heading: Read skills and roles first
sections.body: Review each hero’s skills, troop type and supported modes. Battles, exploration and other activities may call for different choices; do not rely on one number alone.

sections.heading: Plan around your current heroes
sections.body: Take stock of your heroes and materials, then prioritize the teams you use most. Check the purpose and sources of rare shards and equipment before spending them.

sections.heading: Keep notes from actual play
sections.body: Record how teams perform in comparable situations before making changes. These notes do not provide unverified rankings or a fixed best team.

guides.title: Joining an alliance: start with cooperation
guides.summary: Find a suitable alliance and understand its communication and participation rules.

sections.heading: Choose an alliance that fits
sections.body: Read alliance descriptions and check their main language, active hours and participation requirements. Choose a pace that works with your schedule.

sections.heading: Follow announcements and plans
sections.body: Before an event, read alliance announcements for the meeting time, objective and participation instructions. Ask alliance leaders when a rule is unclear.

sections.heading: Use the in-game information
sections.body: Help, technology and event limits may change with updates. Check the current in-game rules before taking part.

guides.title: Resource management: prepare for your next build
guides.summary: Review resource sources, requirements and items to make your upgrade plan clearer.

sections.heading: Review your current needs
sections.body: Decide on your next construction or research goal, then identify the resources you lack. Avoid using all your items before you have a clear goal.

sections.heading: Check resource sources
sections.body: Use in-game source information to find tasks, gathering and other ways to obtain resources. Plan around the features you have unlocked.

sections.heading: Use items when you need them
sections.body: Time resource-item use around your next objective. Read item descriptions and protection rules; this sample is not a fixed strategy.

guides.title: Event notes: read the rules before joining
guides.summary: A simple checklist for event timing, rewards and the resources you can commit.

sections.heading: Check timing and rules
sections.body: Open the event page to review remaining time, scoring and reward requirements. Event schedules may differ between servers.

sections.heading: Set a realistic goal
sections.body: Review your available resources and time before choosing a target. Keep your commitment within your own limits rather than following sample advice blindly.

sections.heading: Review your results
sections.body: After the event, record what you achieved and what you spent. Use those notes to prepare for your next attempt.
